draft.title: The greenhouse effect and climate
card: Earth absorbs energy from the Sun, mostly as visible light. The warm surface then emits energy back towards space as infrared radiation.
Greenhouse gases, such as carbon dioxide, methane and water vapour, absorb some of this infrared radiation. They then re-emit it in all directions, including back down to the surface.
This extra energy returning to the surface keeps Earth warmer than it would be without these gases. This is the greenhouse effect, and it is a natural process.
Adding more greenhouse gases to the atmosphere means more infrared radiation is absorbed and re-emitted downwards. This warms the surface further and changes the climate.
draft.remember: Greenhouse gases trap infrared radiation from the surface, so more gas means more warming.

a.q: Which process is the greenhouse effect?
opts: Gases absorb and re-emit infrared from Earth's surface
Gases block sunlight so less of it reaches the surface
Gases reflect visible light from the Sun back into space
Gases create new thermal energy inside the atmosphere
a.why: The surface emits infrared, and greenhouse gases absorb it and re-emit some of it back down, which warms the surface. The gases do not block sunlight or make new energy. Blocking sunlight would cool Earth, not warm it.
a.clue: Think about what the warm surface sends out, and what happens to it.

b.q: Over many years, the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere above a region rises. What is the most direct effect on energy at the surface?
opts: More infrared is re-emitted downwards to the surface
Less infrared leaves the surface in the first place
More visible light is emitted by the surface
Less sunlight is absorbed by the surface
b.why: More carbon dioxide absorbs more of the surface's infrared and re-emits more of it back down, so the surface warms. The surface does not emit less infrared, since that depends on its temperature. Visible light from the Sun is not what the extra gas changes.
b.clue: Which radiation do greenhouse gases interact with?

a.best: Gases absorb and re-emit infrared from Earth's surface

b.best: More infrared is re-emitted downwards to the surface
